title: dgt-cos-trajectories: land-use/land-cover history of sample points from the DGT COS series
description:
ArcGIS Pro toolbox and Python command-line tool that extracts the land-use/land-cover history of point samples from the Carta de Uso e Ocupação do Solo (COS) of mainland Portugal, published by the Direção-Geral do Território (DGT).

For each sample point the tool reads the COS class in every edition of one COS series (Series 1: 1995–2018; Series 2: 2018–2025) and returns the class trajectory, temporal-stability metrics, the distance to the polygon boundary and an interpretation category, together with transition matrices, a provenance manifest and a data dictionary. The mathematical definitions and an interpretation guide are included in the documentation.

The COS data are not distributed with the software.
keywords: Carta de Uso e Ocupação do Solo
